articles.title: Swedish party leaders race to meet Centre Party's coalition deadline

articles.title: OPINION: Sweden's Migration Agency is not fit for purpose. It should be scrapped

It demonstrates why the agency is no longer capable of doing its job and now needs to be replaced, argues James Savage.
